notes:
Summary: Emberly is a mid-market B2B SaaS (knowledge worker / product docs search) evaluating Redwood for a reranking tier. Primary ask: plug Redwood rerank endpoint into their offline scoring pipeline and run large-scale offline evals, then compare hosted API latency/cost vs Dedicated reserved capacity for steady rerank batches.

- Initial interest: Reranking for search result lists (top-100 candidate generation in ES, top-10 final rerank).
- Requirements: batch offline scoring at ~5k queries/day for evaluation, production throughput target 80 qps for batched offline scoring, 95th pct tail latency for per-request online rerank < 120ms (goal 60-80ms).
- Model prefs: prefer open Llama-family for control, but open to Redwood curated model if cost-effective and supports quantization. Need ability to pin model versions and fallback rules.
- Evaluation needs: stable eval set (30k labeled pairs), metric suite (MRR@10, NDCG@10, pairwise accuracy). Want exportable evaluation reports and diffs.
- Offline scoring: must be able to run large batches with deterministic tokenization and same tokenizer as hosted runtime. Concern: tokenization differences observed when testing with other providers.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required; SSO via SAML (Okta), audit logs for queries and model versioning, optional KMS integration for key material. Data residency preference: US-only.
- Economics: cost sensitivity in prod — volume expected to scale when feature turned on; exploring hosted to validate quality, then move to Dedicated if cost/latency favors it. Asked for committed pricing examples for 500k queries/mo rerank and for dedicated pool sizing guidance.
- Quote from Head of Search (call): "We need deterministic rerank outputs for A/B tests — any nondeterminism will blow up our experiment noise. Also, offline scoring must match online outputs closely."
- Integration notes: they currently use ElasticSearch candidate generator + internal features (click signals, freshness). Plan: Redwood reranker will accept candidate list + features. Need an example contract for candidate input (ids, contextual signals).
- Risks: label quality (team will re-label subset), procurement timeline (legal review for Dedicated contract), minor concerns about cold-start costs for dedicated GPU pool.

POC scope agreed: run 30k eval set through Redwood hosted rerank endpoint, return scores, compute MRR/NDCG. If metrics reach threshold, schedule Dedicated sizing conversation and pricing. POC deadline: 2026-04-18.

Open technical questions for SE: "Does Redwood reranker maintain tokenization parity for Llama-based models?" "Can we run an offline scoring job that uses the same quantized model used in Dedicated?" "What's the expected delta between hosted and dedicated output determinism?"
